description: This source file provides functions related to SHA-1 collision detection and verification within a Git-related cryptographic utility, wrapping and extending SHA1DC functions, with specific handling for collision attack scenarios.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCInit(SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 context and disables safe hash saving by default

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCFinal(unsigned char hash[20],SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash and triggers a fatal error if a collision is detected

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX * ctx,const void * vdata,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Updates SHA1 context with data, handling large data inputs by chunking

ctags.name: git_SHA1DCUpdate
ctags.pattern: /^void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX *ctx, const void *vdata, unsigned long len)$/
